summary: A candidate outside a city hall says a very large gift to a committee must expect something back and calls for transparency.
realLife: A third-place candidate held a press conference about one little-known donor's gifts to a committee backing his rivals, saying a gift that size expects something; the favored candidate denied any tie to the committee.
